eyebrow: First connection to a new host
code:
$ ssh deploy@web01.northbridgeretail.internal
The authenticity of host 'web01...' can't be established.
ED25519 key fingerprint is SHA256:9fK3mZ...
Are you sure you want to continue connecting (yes/no)?
caption: SSH records the server's identity so it can detect if it ever changes unexpectedly

eyebrow: No password ever sent over the wire

steps.label: Private key stays on your machine
Public key goes on the server

eyebrow: Generate a key pair, then copy the public half over
code:
$ ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "deploy@northbridgeretail.com"
Generating public/private ed25519 key pair.

$ ssh-copy-id deploy@web01.northbridgeretail.internal
Number of key(s) added: 1
caption: ssh-copy-id appends your .pub file to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server

eyebrow: Copy files over the same connection, with a shortcut for the host
code:
$ scp deploy-report.txt deploy@web01...:/opt/northbridge/

# ~/.ssh/config
Host web01
    HostName web01.northbridgeretail.internal
    User deploy

$ ssh web01
caption: scp reuses SSH auth; ~/.ssh/config turns a long command into a short alias

subtitle: Locking down SSH itself, and everything else exposed on this box.
